discrepancies.explanation: No point discrepancy: statsExpressions 2.1.1 passes correct=FALSE to both test and raw-table effectsize call. effectsize 1.0.3 internally builds a default Yates htest but .effectsize_chisq.test_dep recomputes uncorrected .chisq(Obs,Exp). Raw table, Yates htest and uncorrected htest therefore give the same Bergsma point.
